# KernLens

> Linux kernel debugging from Python and GDB: 30 commands, a
> pure-Python core, and a startup file sourced inside GDB.

- Site: https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/
- Source: https://github.com/BinRacer/KernLens
- Install: https://github.com/BinRacer/KernLens/blob/main/install.sh

## Pages

- [Overview](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/): what KernLens is, the demo, the install, and the command summary
- [Commands](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/commands/): every command and alias, generated from the registry
- [Index](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/): one page per command, with output captured from a real kernel
- [kl-status](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-status/): Shows the KernLens version, color mode, KASLR slide, and layout.
- [kl-base](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-base/): Reports the runtime kernel text base and KASLR slide.
- [kl-kcmdline](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-kcmdline/): Return the kernel command line (/proc/cmdline).
- [kl-kversion](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-kversion/): Outputs the kernel version (/proc/version).
- [kl-kconfig](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-kconfig/): Outputs the kernel config (/proc/config.gz).
- [kl-kmod](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-kmod/): Displays the loaded Linux kernel modules.
- [kl-ksyscalls](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-ksyscalls/): Displays the Linux syscall table, including names and addresses of syscalls.
- [kl-kdmesg](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-kdmesg/): Displays the kernel ring buffer (dmesg) contents.
- [kl-addr](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-addr/): Classifies an address and reports where it maps.
- [kl-pt](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-pt/): Splits a virtual address into page-table indices, or decodes a page-table entry.
- [kl-walk](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-walk/): Walks the live page tables and decodes every level.
- [kl-p2v](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-p2v/): Translates a physical address to virtual + struct page.
- [kl-v2p](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-v2p/): Translates a virtual address (live page tables) to physical.
- [kl-pageinfo](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-pageinfo/): Translates a struct page to virtual and physical addresses.
- [kl-buddy](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-buddy/): Locates an address in the buddy allocator: its zone, its free block, and where it sits inside that block.
- [kl-slab](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-slab/): Prints information about the linux kernel's slab allocator SLUB.
- [kl-sym](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-sym/): Resolves an address to a symbol, or finds symbols by name.
- [kl-bt](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-bt/): Prints a formatted kernel backtrace.
- [kl-read](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-read/): Dumps kernel memory as 64-bit words with symbol annotations.
- [kl-kvar](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-kvar/): Reads a KASLR-aware kernel global variable.
- [kl-read-field](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-read-field/): Reads a struct field (including nested paths) as an integer.
- [kl-kbpf](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-kbpf/): Prints information about the linux kernel bpf progs and maps.
- [kl-kdmabuf](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-kdmabuf/): Prints DMA buf info.
- [kl-cpu](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-cpu/): Displays CPU topology, the online mask, and per-CPU offsets.
- [kl-percpu](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-percpu/): Resolves a per-CPU symbol to its runtime address for a CPU.
- [kl-msr](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-msr/): Reads or writes x86_64 model-specific registers (via GDB).
- [kl-bits](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-bits/): Inspects a 64-bit value; optionally test/set/clear a bit.
- [kl-int](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-int/): Shows signed/unsigned and LE/BE integer views.
- [kl-color](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-color/): Enable, disable, or toggle ANSI color output.
- [kl-help](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/tutorial/kl-help/): Lists every KernLens command, or explains one in detail.
- [Demo container](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/demo-container/): a kernel built from source, booted under QEMU, and attached in GDB
- [Python API](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/api/): the Python API: classes, facade functions, and examples
- [Architecture](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/architecture/): package layout, the loading path, and why the boundaries are there
- [Compatibility](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/compatibility/): which environments were measured, which are expected, and which are not claimed
- [Releasing](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/releasing/): what has to agree before a tag, and what the tag does
- [Naming](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/naming/): command, example, and filename conventions
- [Contributing](https://github.com/BinRacer/KernLens/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security](https://github.com/BinRacer/KernLens/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/BinRacer/KernLens/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## zh-CN

The same pages in Chinese, at their own URLs.  Pages with no
counterpart here are served in English under the Chinese
prefix, so every link works and the language of what you land
on is never a surprise.

- [Overview](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/zh-CN/): the same front page in Chinese
- [Commands](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/zh-CN/commands/): (translation)
- [Index](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/zh-CN/tutorial/): (translation)
- [Demo container](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/zh-CN/demo-container/): (translation)
- [Python API](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/zh-CN/api/): the same API reference in Chinese
- [Architecture](https://binracer.github.io/KernLens/zh-CN/architecture/): (translation)
